about: Unfinished Business is a standalone mission related to RoboCop: Rogue City.
They’ve made OmniTower their fortress, and violence is their language. Battle elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower, and enforce the law amidst the chaos!
ROBOCOP IS BACK ON DUTY TO SETTLE UNFINISHED BUSINESS
FIGHT YOUR WAY TO THE TOP FLOOR
Following RoboCop's decisive victory over Detroit's gangs, a new chapter unfolds in this standalone extension set after the events of RoboCop: Rogue City.
The New Guy in Town has been defeated, but the streets are still riddled with crime.
summary: Unfinished Business is a new standalone adventure of RoboCop: Rogue City. OmniTower is their fortress, violence their language. Face elite mercenaries all the way to the top of the tower and enforce the law amidst the chaos!
